inputs.checklistItemText: Trees not shown on landscape plan in relation to overhead electric facilities, preventing clearance verification
inputs.question: Are overhead electric lines (including poles and conductors) clearly shown on the landscape plan alongside the tree locations? Can you see both the electric infrastructure and tree symbols on the same drawing to verify clearances?

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/visibility question—whether both overhead electric infrastructure and trees are depicted together on the landscape plan—which is a prerequisite sheet-discovery and feature-presence check before any clearance measurement could occur. This is progressive verification; the actual clearance measurement would come later.
